subject: E-4355: crash on launch on Windows
body:
Hello support team. We run PixelForge 6.0.6 on Windows 11 23H2. Starting this
morning, the moment I open the app a dialog reads 'E-4355: application crashed
on launch'.

It started after I set the display scaling to 150 percent. At 100 percent
scaling there is no crash.

Before writing in I tried logging out of my browser; same error afterwards.

Regards, Fatima Zahra, Caldera Foods
